children: CONX finalized post-merger arrangements for HC2 Broadcasting by entering into a new LLC Agreement on Sep 02 2026 and simultaneously extinguished a $105 million bridge loan originally dated May 29 2026. The governance pact gives CONX two of three board seats and preserves minority protections for the seller, while setting customary capital and transfer rights. The bridge loan was terminated at closing with no exit fees, streamlining the entity’s capital structure following completion of the merger.

: Set post-merger governance and minority protections
: Superseded by merger closing; debt extinguished
